definitions.sample: Same recorded canonical recipes paired by index/seed/fixture. Full100 and paired50 are distinct populations.
definitions.context: Category partitions; other context rows overlap. Scores are option estimates, not calibrated goal probabilities. Pressure0.2 and score0.65 are descriptive bins.
definitions.saves: Goals have priority over physical keeper touch. Conventional saves/(saves+goals) and all-attempt save share are separate.
definitions.unavailableBaseline: v2 original records lack exact observer transition starts, continuous contact pairs, explicit whistles and independent opportunityQuality. Their half assignment uses official-clock inference at protected boundaries.
definitions.duration: Final v21 observed canonical first-to-last event span. Earlier v21 pilot numerical meanPossessionSeconds used3600/attacks and is a rate-equivalent estimate, not independently observed span.
definitions.performance: Wall times include observer/frame capture and concurrent load; not isolated speedup evidence.
